title: Spoken quote
description: Someone's own words. With their clip the person stands full height on one side (only framed, slowly pushed in), the quote sits on the free side, a gold quotation mark draws itself and a warm highlight passes over the words as if a voice reads them. Without a picture the quote is centred in serif with a slow light behind.

props.text: required, the person's own words, word for word
props.gold: a word or words to colour gold
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face, 0 to 1
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the person

example.alt: A person talking to the camera
